searchText: If we seed a Portal Network with only one testnet's data, which one should we pick? 🇭 Holesky 🇸 Sepolia 🇩 Devnet-N 🇴 Other network 🇲 Need More than 1 🇾 It's not really helpful to test Portal integrations with Testnet data relevant maybe, holesky doesn't have a pre-merge section I think broadly it makes sense that portal mirrors all "standard" testnets as it begins its journey to become critical core client infrastructure Other people from Nimbus team have since discussed this and come to a similar conclusion as Jacek has discussed here, against bumping I think <@543900561460822016> is the only person who I believe has independently advocated for the bump, so I'd like to hear what he has to say. As well as anyone else who wants to further advocate for the bump. Given that I'm not representing a client I'm no longer going to advocate for the bump myself. Also <@429719902363058177> was in support of the bump. Can you contextualize that support? Are you strongly in support and wish to argue for it? Or are you happy acquiescing to whatever the majority decides? And lacking the bump, how do teams propose that this change should be added to the DevP2P specification documents? I'm happy to withdraw the proposal to bump the version if people are confident we will handle the asymmetric updates gracefully, which it sounds like people are <@194432762315407360> 's proposal about a status in /69 seems fine to me, however it's expressed ("error response" or special message) or indeed, we make 70 _remove_ block downloads from the core eth protocol and move them to a separate subproto I think this is just overcomplicating stuff i would suggest just keeping it simple - honestly, i do not see a single reason to change the protocol in response to history expiry at all so I would rather not do anything from that perspective I also don't think this should be included as part of this process. It would greatly increase the overhead and testing burden where currently we have a path forward that is largely unencumbered by much of any additional need to agree on changes or specify anything new.

excerpts.author: jason.carver
excerpts.content:
If we seed a Portal Network with only one testnet's data, which one should we pick?
🇭  Holesky 🇸  Sepolia 🇩  Devnet-N 🇴  Other network 🇲  Need More than 1  🇾  It's not really helpful to test Portal integrations with Testnet data
